list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions and grades as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them on 2026-11-18; the two agree on every name, description and grade). 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.
guideNote: Every guide below is written in our own words from the trophy's official description. Where a step has not yet been checked in the game, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing a location. Sources for each trophy's name, description and grade are Exophase and PSNProfiles; the guide advice itself is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. There is no separate task for it: work through the roadmap in order — story, side missions, activities, collectibles, then the 100% cleanup — and the platinum is the last thing you earn.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this trophy comes from simply starting the story and playing through the intro. No preparation is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play the story missions in order until the chapter closes; the trophy unlocks automatically at the end of the chapter. Story trophies cannot be missed — keep playing and it will come.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep playing the story missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. Like every chapter trophy, it is automatic story progress.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Play through the chapter's story missions in order until it closes. The trophy is automatic — no side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish the chapter's story missions in order; the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. This is the last numbered chapter trophy before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the story's last mission and this gold trophy unlocks automatically. The official description names no mission title, so expect it to be the story finale — not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Follow the story until this mission appears and finish it. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — it will come up as you play.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. This is a named story mission — play the story until it appears and finish it. Heist missions in GTA games are story beats, so it unlocks through normal play.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A named story mission: follow the story until it appears and finish it. No side content is needed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A named story mission — play the story until it appears and finish it. It unlocks through normal story progress.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A named story mission set around Vice City International Airport — follow the story until it appears and finish it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission — follow the story until it appears and finish it. It unlocks through normal play.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long one: in GTA games 100% covers the story, side missions, activities and collectibles together. Use this guide's checklist to track every category and finish them all; the gold unlocks only when every completion item is done. The exact 100% checklist for GTA VI is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, spins and airtime tricks while driving or riding. Build the count gradually across the whole playthrough — every jump counts, so there is no single place to grind it. The description does not say which moves count as stunts, so treat any stunt jump or trick as progress until confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Play one of every activity type the game offers — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation and the rest. Open the activities list as you explore Leonida and tick each type off once. The official description does not name the activity types, so the exact count is not yet confirmed.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting range and work through the challenges, aiming for gold on each one. The count of 42 comes from PSNProfiles; the challenges themselves are not yet mapped, so expect weapon and target variety across the range.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find every Top Fun drone race location in Leonida and win a race at each one. The number of locations is not stated in the official description, so check each location off as you find it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. All 20 must be different — repeating the same race does not count. Mix race types and locations across the map and keep a note of which ones you have won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take on his fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Fishing challenges are an activity, so look for Cal at fishing spots; the exact spot is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine and play a game through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you find.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand until its final mission and finish it. Character strands unlock as the story progresses, so keep checking in with Andy between story beats.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's mission strand until its final mission and finish it. Character strands unlock as the story progresses.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work through Billy's mission strand until its final mission and finish it. Character strands unlock as the story progresses.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as side-mission givers around the map; complete eight full strands. Watch for stranger icons while exploring and finish each strand you start.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's mission strand until its final mission and finish it. Character strands unlock as the story progresses.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's mission strand until its final mission and finish it. Character strands unlock as the story progresses.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Find every meditation spot on the map and meditate at each one. The number of spots is not stated in the official description, so mark each one you find as you explore.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret asks you to hunt one specific unique animal; follow his lead to the animal's location and take it down. The animal and its location are not named in the official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida; complete three full sets. Cards are a collectible, so expect to hunt them across the whole map — the size of each set is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is a location-based activity — visit 100 different spots and do it at each one. Work through the map region by region so you do not lose track of where you have been.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's assorted side objectives; complete 50 of them across all types. They accumulate through normal play, so keep an eye on the challenges list as you play and mop up the easy ones last.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Use a fast car and break line of sight; your partner must be present for it to count.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner alongside, rob three shops in a row while keeping the same wanted level — do not let it drop between robberies. Plan a route with three shops close together.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Find and get into 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Every new vehicle you enter counts toward discovery, so try everything you see — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus — the game's slowed-down aiming — and take down five enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with a group of enemies and line the shots up while time is slowed.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: The description points at one specific event at the airport — an unscheduled departure — so treat it as a one-off moment and do it when the chance appears rather than assuming it can be repeated.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the airport did not schedule — steal a plane and take off. Expect this to draw attention; the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank — the description's joke points at the military vehicle — and the trophy should follow from driving or using it. Tanks are usually found at military sites; the exact method is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case a jewelry store, get in and out without raising the alarm. Go quiet: avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone spots you. If you are seen, leave and try again — the attempt can be repeated.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Banks are high-risk jobs, so plan the escape route before you go in and count each clean getaway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, rob it and escape. Trucks move around the map, so watch for them on highways and in the city, and have a getaway car ready.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every region of the map until the whole state is uncovered. Drive, fly and sail across the map; the trophy pops when the last area is revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations; rob one operation per gang. Learn which gangs hold which territory and hit each gang's operation once.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: The description reads as one specific story moment — a cocktail with a view — so do it when the chance appears in the story rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and have a cocktail. This reads as a one-off story moment, so take the chance when it appears.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's frontage and out the other side. Pick a showroom, build speed and go straight through.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — the follow-through suggests completing a game or a shot there. The exact requirement is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: The description gives no concrete step but ties the trophy to a partnership moment, so it is flagged as possibly missable: watch for partnership activities in the story and do not skip them.
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to your partnership — most likely a story or activity moment with your partner. The description gives no concrete step, so treat it as a story-linked moment and watch for partnership activities as you play.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE — tied to a story choice. Choices in GTA VI can lock out the alternative, so think before you pick and keep a save from before any big decision.
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This trophy is tied to a story choice. A choice can lock you out of the alternative, so this is missable: think before you pick, and keep a save from before any big decision. The exact choice is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: The description suggests something that takes a second attempt — a failed first try you retry. Keep a save before risky one-off moments so a second attempt stays possible.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The name suggests something that takes a second attempt — a failed first try that you retry. Keep a save before risky one-off moments so a second attempt is possible. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: The description reads as a secret or one-off strange event in the world. Explore odd corners of Leonida and follow anything unusual you find; treat it as missable until the trigger is mapped.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This reads as a secret or one-off strange event in the world. Explore odd corners of Leonida and follow anything unusual you find; the trigger is not yet confirmed, so treat it as missable until it is mapped.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving past, take out bowling pins — or bowlers — with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The exact target is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money; launder them through your contacts until you have cleaned $250,000. It accumulates over the game, so keep laundering as you earn.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 total in shops — clothes, weapons, cars, anything. It counts across all shops, so normal spending adds up; buy big-ticket items late in the game to finish it off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property available in Leonida. Garages appear on the in-game property market; save money for them and buy each one as it appears.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register ten vehicles you own or find. Open the app on your phone, register a vehicle, and repeat until you reach ten.
